name: Living Alone
overview: Scripture acknowledges the challenges of living alone, portraying solitude as a state that can bring affliction and desolation, as seen in Psalms 25:16. Yet, it also values peace and quietness over strife, emphasizing that a simple, solitary life can be preferable to contentious relationships (Proverbs 17:1; Proverbs 21:19). Isaiah 56:3 reminds believers who feel separated or isolated that their union with the Lord includes them fully in His people, offering hope and belonging despite physical solitude.
